title: Salvage(r) Twilight Forest gear
description: Allows Silent Gear salvager to salvage Twilight Forest gear
body:
**Silent gears salvager now salvages The Twilight Forest gear, tridents, turtle helmets and shields.**

You should get the same materials used to craft said gear back.

Tested on ATM10 (v2.34)

**Install:**
AppData\Roaming\minecraft\saves\your save file\datapacks
